name: cross-cut-e2e-fixture-limits
body: Two limits. (1) The real-repo cross-cut act needs the unchanged target symbol in a different crate because the Rust frontend's --targets filter re-emits a whole targeted crate; upgrade if per-file emission lands. (2) The still-planned half is a hand-built fixture modelling finalize_delta_graph's output because the function is pub(crate); upgrade when a real-repo planned variant can be exercised.
